about_the_game:
Nemorsys is a punishing stealth-action RPG where frontal assaults are fatal.

Forge a dark pact with an ancient wraith and hunt down the corrupted King Murab. But be warned: the power to kill comes at the cost of your humanity.

Outwit relentless enemies, manipulate light sources to create your path, and manage scarce resources in a world where every mistake is fatal.

Your light is fading. Can you master the darkness before it consumes you?

WIELD THE SHADOWS AS A WEAPON

Your pact grants you an ever-shifting arsenal of nightmarish abilities. From blinding fogs to lethal constructs, the darkness provides—but it demands you adapt.

  • Master a roster of 20 unique Shadow abilities ,each deeply influenced by the in‑game darkness and capable of evolving into more lethal forms. Harness the shifting shadows to combine powers, manipulate the battlefield, and create limitless ways to stalk your prey and execute the King.

HUNT OR BE HUNTED

The Dynamic Fog of War is alive. It breathes and shifts with your vision, hiding threats just inches from your face.

  • Dynamic Stealth: Line-of-sight, distance and the ambient light levels determine your survival.

  • Relentless Adversaries: Forget predictable patrols. Enemies coordinate, react to disturbances, and hunt you down. If you are seen, you are likely dead.

A KINGDOM OF RUIN

Your path to vengeance is paved with puzzles and peril.

  • Traverse a Handcrafted Nightmare: Journey from the gore-slicked Eye-Gouger Tunnels and the Darkened Light Temple to the imposing shadows of the King's Castle. Every biome demands new strategies.

  • Weaponize the World: Your blade is lethal, but the environment is your playground. Supplement your combat skills by luring enemies into ancient traps or manipulating the architecture to crush those who stand in your way.

A FRACTURED SOUL

The Nemorsys grants power, but it craves control.

  • Wield the Light: Kaelara is no mere vessel. Master her 5 unique Light Spells to purify enemies and protect yourself from the abyss.

  • Resist the Corruption: Every use of shadow magic invites the Nemorsys in. Push your dark powers too far, and you will be consumed by the shadow—losing Kaelara’s humanity and severing your connection to her Light Spells forever. Balance is your only survival.

The King sits on a throne of lies. The shadows are calling. Will you answer?

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains mature themes and graphic content that may not be suitable for all players. Expect to encounter scenes of gore, violence, and references to suicide, sacrifice, corruption, torture, and murder. These elements are integral to the storyline and atmosphere, providing a dark and immersive experience. Player discretion is advised.

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 760 or AMD Radeon R9 270X with 2 GB VRAM

  • Memory: 16 GB RAM

  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: Join Kaelara on her quest for revenge against a tyrannical king. Become the Nemorsys, an ancient spirit of darkness, in this action stealth game where shadow and light shape every ability, and effect. Use powerful shadow powers, solve puzzles, and fight to overthrow an evil king.
